title: Introduction to sfclust
text: model-based approach spatial clustering requires defining within-cluster model, regions within cluster share common parameters latent functions. example, given clustering partition MM, assume observed number cases (yity_{}) region ii time tt realization Binomial random variable YitY_{} size NitN_{} success probability pitp_{}: Yit∣pit,Nit,M∼indBinomial(Nit,pit). Y_{} \mid p_{}, N_{}, M \stackrel{ind}{\sim} \text{Binomial}(N_{}, p_{}). Based exploratory analysis, success probability pitp_{} modeled : logit(pit)=αci+𝐱tT𝛃ci+fit, \text{logit}(p_{}) =  \alpha_{c_i} + \boldsymbol{x}_{t}^T\boldsymbol{\beta}_{c_i} + f_{},  αci\alpha_{c_i} intercept cluster cic_i, 𝐱t\boldsymbol{x}_{t} represents set polynomial functions time capture global trends cluster-specific effect 𝛃ci\boldsymbol{\beta}_{c_i}. Additionally, include independent random effect, fit∼iidNormal(0,σci)f_{} \stackrel{iid}{\sim} \text{Normal}(0, \sigma_{c_i}), account extra space-time variability. Since perform Bayesian inference, impose prior distributions model parameters. intercept αci\alpha_{c_i} regression coefficients 𝛃ci\boldsymbol{\beta}_{c_i} follow Normal distribution, prior hyperparameter σci\sigma_{c_i} defined : log⁡(1/σci)∼LogGamma(1,10−5). \log(1/\sigma_{c_i}) \sim \text{LogGamma}(1, 10^{-5}).  Notably, regions within cluster share parameters: αci\alpha_{c_i}, regression coefficients 𝛃ci\boldsymbol{\beta}_{c_i}, random-effect standard deviation σci\sigma_{c_i}.

title: Introduction to sfclust
text: order perform Bayesian spatial functional clustering model use main function sfclust. main arguments function : x: spatio-temporal data stars object. nclust: initial number clusters. spnames: Names spatial dimensions (auto-detected provided; typically "geometry" vector data, c("x", "y") raster data). fnames: Names functional dimensions. parameter data.frame interface ; stars interface derived automatically dimensions spnames (e.g. "time") user-settable. niter: Number iteration Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm. Notice given sfclust uses MCMC INLA perform Bayesian inference, accepts argument INLA::inla function. main arguments : formula: expression define model fixed random effects. sfclust pre-processes data creates identifiers regions ids, functional indices id_<dimname> (e.g. id_time) space-time id. can include identifiers formula. family: distribution response variable. Ntrials: Number trials case Binomial response. E: Expected number cases Poisson response. following code performs Bayesian functional clustering model explained 2000 iterations. returned object class sfclust, list two elements: samples: list containing membership samples, logarithm marginal likelihood log_mlike clustering movements move_counts done total. clust: list containing selected membership samples. includes id selected sample, selected membership models associated cluster.
code: set.seed(7) result <- sfclust(stbinom, formula = cases ~ poly(time, 2) + f(id),   family = "binomial", Ntrials = population, niter = 2000) names(result) #> [1] "samples" "clust"

title: sfclust 1.1.0
text: Added support raster stars input (x/y grid dimensions), alongside existing vector-geometry input, including new raster_adjacency() internal helper dispatch genclust()/sfclust(). Added chapa, real NDWI2 vegetation-index raster dataset El Chaparrillo, Spain, new article vignette demonstrating raster clustering (vg13-ndwi-chaparrillo.Rmd). Cells missing/NA response values (e.g. raster cells outside study region) now automatically excluded clustering via response / valid_ids, instead requiring user pre-filter data. Added update() methods sfclust objects: niter continues MCMC sampling previous fit left , sample refits full INLA models specific stored sample without sampling. Generalized spatial/functional dimension handling (spnames/fnames) spatial dimension names longer need match fixed convention. plot_clusters_fitted()/fitted() gained inv_link/aggregation options, returning cluster-level (mean_cluster) inverse-link (mean_cluster_inv) summaries.

title: sfclust 1.1.0
text: Internal architecture reworked: sfclust() now dispatches sfclust.data.frame() (core interface) sfclust.stars() (spatial convenience wrapper), replacing previous single-path implementation. data_all()/filter_df() replace old stnames-based long-format conversion.

title: sfclust 1.1.0
text: Fixed corner cases NULL fitted models raster inputs. Fixed adjacency handling custom/user-supplied adjacency matrices point-geometry plotting. Fixed cluster-level aggregation fitted values plots. fitted()/plot() longer require INLA installed applied already-fitted sfclust object (e.g. one loaded saved .rds); inverse-link transform standard families (gaussian, binomial, poisson) now computed natively instead via INLA::inla.link.inv*().
